name: Team Charmander: Thunderous Anti-Air & Pyro Momentum
archetype: Electric anti-air, Fire STAB wallbreaking, and Intimidate physical pivot.
gym_duel_rationale: Falkner's aerial team requires tactical precision around abilities and held items: Charizard/Venusaur levels to Cap 63 to anchor the frontline, using Flamethrower against Steel/Fighting fusions and pacifying Ursaring/Pidgeot with Sleep Powder; Alakazam/Raichu cleanly electrocutes Xatu/Noctowl and Ursaring/Pidgeot with Thunderbolt, smartly bypassing Marowak/Dustox's Lightning Rod by blasting it with STAB Psychic; Gyarados/Nidoking blunts Ursaring/Pidgeot with Intimidate and pops Skarmory/Houndoom's Air Balloon with Aqua Tail; Primeape/Sandslash delivers Close Combat against Skarmory/Houndoom; and Snorlax absorbs Flying moves with massive HP and Rest.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor elevated to Cap 63. Flamethrower melts Granbull/Combusken and Skarmory/Houndoom. Sleep Powder immediately halts Ursaring/Pidgeot.
522 BST physical pivot. Intimidate neutralizes Ursaring/Pidgeot's Attack on switch-in. Aqua Tail pops Skarmory/Houndoom's Air Balloon and washes away Marowak/Dustox.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. Thunderbolt electrocutes Xatu/Noctowl and Ursaring/Pidgeot. STAB Psychic bypasses Marowak/Dustox's Lightning Rod.
477 BST wallbreaker. Vital Spirit prevents sleep. STAB Close Combat delivers massive super-effective damage to crush Skarmory/Houndoom.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray Flying and Fire attacks comfortably, recovering to full health with Rest and Sleep Talk.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Ice Beam cleanly freezes Flying and Dragon threats across Route 32 and coastal waterways.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind speed doubling and Roost recovery.
Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb against physical attackers.
Iron Fist-boosted Thunder Punch and Ice Punch for versatile tech coverage.
